name: sso-oidc
description: IAM Identity Center OpenID Connect (OIDC) is a web service that enables a client (such as CLI or a native application) to register with IAM Identity Center.

subcommands.name: create-token
subcommands.description: Creates and returns access and refresh tokens for clients that are authenticated using client secrets.

options.name: --client-id
options.description: The unique identifier string for the client or application.

options.name: --client-secret
options.description: A secret string generated for the client.

options.name: --grant-type
options.description: Supports the following OAuth grant types: Device Code and Refresh Token.

options.name: --device-code
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Device Code grant type.

options.name: --code
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Authorization Code grant type.

options.name: --refresh-token
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Refresh Token grant type.

options.name: --scope
options.description: The list of scopes for which authorization is requested.

options.name: --redirect-uri
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Authorization Code grant type.

options.name: --code-verifier
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Authorization Code grant type.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

options.name: --refresh-token

options.name: --assertion

options.name: --scope

options.name: --redirect-uri

options.name: --subject-token

options.name: --subject-token-type
options.description: Used only when calling this API for the Token Exchange grant type.

options.name: --requested-token-type

options.name: --code-verifier

subcommands.description: Registers a client with IAM Identity Center.

options.description: The friendly name of the client

options.name: --client-type
options.description: The type of client.

options.name: --scopes
options.description: The list of scopes that are defined by the client.

options.name: --redirect-uris

options.name: --grant-types
options.description: The list of OAuth 2.0 grant types that are defined by the client.

options.name: --issuer-url
options.description: The IAM Identity Center Issuer URL associated with an instance of IAM Identity Center.
